in_hebrew.name: מִכָּאל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Mikkel is derived from the Hebrew phrase ‘mikha el’ which means ‘who is like God?’ This name is a declaration of faith and acknowledgement of God’s supremacy.

in_greek.name: Μιχαήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Mikkel in Greek is transliterated as Michaël. This name is derived from the Hebrew phrase ‘mikha el’ which means ‘who is like God?’ and is a declaration of faith and acknowledgement of God’s supremacy.

in_latin.name: Michael
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Mikkel in Latin is transliterated as Michael. This name is derived from the Hebrew phrase ‘mikha el’ which means ‘who is like God?’ and is a declaration of faith and acknowledgement of God’s supremacy.
